evals.prompt: est-ce qu'il y a des trucs aujourd'hui ?
evals.expected_output: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) flagged as possibly affected: Dockerfile php:8.3-fpm is a floating branch tag; asks for or explains how to check the production PHP version; proposes pinning/bumping to 8.3.36; checks Symfony advisories and runs composer audit.
assertions: Treats the project as possibly affected by PHP2Shell because php:8.3-fpm is a floating tag, and recommends 8.3.36
Asks the user which PHP version actually runs in production, with the command to find it
Cites at least one CERT alert (CERT-FR or CERT-EU) or the php-src GitHub advisory as source
Gives a temporary mitigation for when the redeploy cannot happen at once
Has an explicit statement of what could not be checked
Did not modify any project file

evals.prompt: on est concernés par la faille Node de cette semaine ?
evals.expected_output: Yes: node:22.23.3 is below 22.23.4; Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497) reachable because server.js uses fetch() on a user-supplied URL (also relevant to the TLS hostname bypass items); proposes bumping the image to 22.23.4; npm audit result reported.
assertions: Says node:22.23.3 is affected and recommends node:22.23.4-alpine
Links the Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497) to fetch() on a user-supplied URL in server.js
States whether active exploitation is reported (CISA KEV, CERT)
Ran a dependency audit (npm audit or equivalent) and reported its limits
Has an explicit statement of what could not be checked
Did not modify any project file
